video_title: Run Your World - Performance Meets Style
video_hook: Runner's feet hitting pavement in slow motion at sunrise, creating a rhythmic visual beat
target_audience: Active lifestyle enthusiasts, runners, and fitness-conscious individuals aged 18-35
video_objective: Showcase the running shoes in authentic lifestyle contexts to inspire viewers to embrace an active lifestyle and purchase the product

scenes.scene_purpose: Establish the beginning of an active day and introduce the product naturally
scenes.setting: Modern bedroom and entryway with natural morning light

frames.visual_prompt: Extreme closeup of hands lacing up the black athletic running shoes with red and white accents. Soft golden morning light streams through a nearby window, highlighting the mesh texture and swoosh logo. The white midsole catches the light beautifully. Shot in slow motion with shallow depth of field.
frames.lighting: soft natural golden hour light from window
frames.background_details: Blurred wooden floor and minimalist bedroom setting

frames.visual_prompt: Medium shot of athletic person in workout gear sitting on bed edge, finishing tying their shoes. Camera positioned low angle looking up, creating an empowering perspective. Natural morning light creates rim lighting around the subject. The black shoes with red accents stand out against the neutral bedroom tones.
frames.lighting: natural morning light with rim lighting effect
frames.background_details: Modern minimalist bedroom with white bedding and plants

scenes.scene_purpose: Show the shoes in action during city running and lifestyle activities
scenes.setting: Urban cityscape with modern architecture and street elements

frames.visual_prompt: Tracking shot following the runner's feet as they move across various urban surfaces - concrete sidewalk, metal grating, stairs. The black shoes with white midsole provide striking contrast against the gray urban textures. Shot from ground level with dynamic movement, capturing the rhythm of running.
frames.lighting: bright daylight with some shadows from buildings
frames.background_details: Urban concrete surfaces, metal textures, city street elements

frames.visual_prompt: Wide shot of runner crossing a modern urban plaza with glass buildings in background. The runner is captured mid-stride, showing the full silhouette and the shoes' performance in action. Dramatic shadows create visual interest on the ground. Color grade emphasizes the urban aesthetic with cool tones.
frames.lighting: bright urban daylight with dramatic shadows
frames.background_details: Modern glass buildings, urban plaza with geometric patterns

frames.visual_prompt: POV shot from runner's perspective looking down at their feet during a run. The black shoes with red accents are clearly visible against the moving pavement. Shot captures the natural bounce and rhythm of running, with the white midsole compression visible. Handheld camera creates authentic running experience.
frames.lighting: natural outdoor lighting with moving shadows
frames.background_details: Moving pavement and street surfaces from runner's perspective

scenes.scene_purpose: Highlight the technical features and performance benefits of the shoe
scenes.setting: Modern fitness environment and clean studio space

frames.visual_prompt: Extreme closeup of the shoe's sole making contact with the ground, captured in super slow motion. The black rubber outsole's traction pattern is clearly visible, and the white midsole shows slight compression. Dramatic side lighting creates strong contrast and highlights the shoe's technical construction.
frames.lighting: dramatic side lighting with strong contrast
frames.background_details: Clean white studio floor with subtle texture

frames.visual_prompt: Medium shot of athlete's legs during dynamic movement - jumping or quick direction changes. The shoes are captured at the moment of impact, showing their stability and support. Shot from low angle to emphasize power and performance. The red and white accents pop against the black base.
frames.lighting: bright even lighting with subtle shadows
frames.background_details: Modern gym environment with clean lines and neutral colors

scenes.scene_purpose: Show the shoes as part of an active, stylish lifestyle beyond just running
scenes.setting: Coffee shop and casual urban environment

frames.visual_prompt: Full shot of person sitting casually at outdoor cafe table, legs extended showing the black athletic shoes with red and white accents paired with casual athleisure wear. Natural golden hour light creates warm, inviting atmosphere. The shoes look stylish and versatile in this relaxed setting.
frames.background_details: Outdoor cafe setting with urban street view and pedestrians

frames.visual_prompt: Overhead shot of the shoes positioned next to lifestyle accessories - water bottle, phone, earbuds, and gym bag on a wooden table surface. The composition is styled like a flatlay with natural shadows. The black shoes with colorful accents serve as the hero product in this lifestyle arrangement.
frames.lighting: soft diffused natural light from above
frames.background_details: Wooden table surface with natural grain and texture

frames.visual_prompt: Closeup of feet walking away from camera on city sidewalk at sunset, with the shoes clearly visible. The shot captures the natural walking gait and the shoes' comfort in everyday use. Warm sunset light creates a cinematic mood with long shadows stretching across the pavement.
frames.lighting: warm sunset backlighting with golden tones
frames.background_details: City sidewalk with urban elements and warm evening atmosphere
